editorial.blurb: Anelya delivers an unforgettable modern take on traditional Ukrainian cuisine, where each carefully crafted dish layers complex, rich flavors and the zakusky cart lets you curate your own appetizer journey.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to share 2-3 plates per course as suggested—even ordering less will leave you delightfully full. Don't miss the appetizer cart display where you can hand-pick your zakusky in person.
